crew.overview: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.
crew.title: Ip Man

details.biography: Long Xiaozhu is a first-line sound engineer in China and a film post-production coordinator. Graduated from the Recording Department of Beijing Film Academy in 1997, with a Master of Arts in MFA in 2009. After graduating from university, she was engaged in film recording and post-production coordinating work. she has participated in the production of dozens of films and has a precise grasp of the style of film and television works and can adapt to works of various themes.
details.name: Xiaozhu Long
